knowledge_graph.description: The JSE Limited is a stock exchange in South Africa, and the largest in Africa by market capitalization. It has been located in Sandton, Gauteng, since it moved from Johannesburg CBD in 2000. As of July 2025, the JSE had a market capitalization of R21 trillion, and a total of 435 listed companies.
